Cities of Light — App Walkthrough —
A quick tour of the app

Cities of Light

From your first sign-in to raffle prizes — every screen, in order, with a note on what it does and why it's there.

Getting Started

Getting In

A single conference-wide code, shared by staff, confirms someone's a real attendee before an account is ever created.

Getting Started

You’re In

A short welcome before profile setup begins — confirms the code worked and sets expectations for the one step still to come.

Getting Started

Sign In, No Password

Attendees sign in with just an email address. No password to create or forget — the app sends a one-time code instead.

Getting Started

One-Time Code

A 6-digit code from their inbox finishes sign-in. Passwordless end to end — one less thing standing between someone and the app.

Getting Started

Building a Profile

Only a first name is required. Photo and social handles are optional, so the people someone meets in person can actually find them afterward.

Your Profile

A Home Base

Photo, name, and social handles in one place — with your contacts one tap away.

The Conference

Stay in the Loop

Conference-wide announcements land here — schedule changes and last-minute details, all in one place instead of scattered texts.

The Conference

The Full Schedule

Every session, grouped by day, with exact times and locations. Nothing to print, nothing to lose track of.

Connecting

Your Personal QR Code

Every attendee gets their own code — the core of how people connect at the conference.

Connecting

Scan to Connect

Point the camera at someone's code, confirm who they are, and send a request — worth 10 points for both of you (15 if you scan them again on a second day).

Connecting

Connected

Once they accept, you're both added to each other's contacts and the points land automatically.

Connecting

Everyone You’ve Met

Every connection lives here, searchable by name or handle — so the person from day one is still there on day three.

Points & Prizes

Earn Your Way to Prizes

Points convert into raffle tickets, assignable to whichever prizes an attendee wants. The more they participate, the better their odds.

Points & Prizes

How It All Works

The rules are never a mystery — a full breakdown of points, ticket costs, and how assignment works is always one tap away.

Points & Prizes

Friendly Competition

Points for connecting with people and checking in to events — standings update about once an hour, and only the top 10 attendees are shown here.

Settings

Simple, Essential Controls

Night mode, profile editing, the privacy policy, and account deletion — the essentials, nothing buried.
